# Did your Terraform plan just print a secret in plaintext?

> Check a Terraform structured plan for secret-shaped values the sensitive flag missed -- deterministic, no account, no upload, with a matching CLI you can run as a CI gate before every apply.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
